privileged_info_for_vlm: The official URLs are https://www.photopea.com, https://excalidraw.com, and https://devdocs.io. In Microsoft Edge, PWAs are installed by clicking the 'App available' icon (three squares and a plus) in the address bar or via Settings > Apps > Install this site as an app. The final verification should show these three apps as distinct windows or listed in the Windows Start Menu.
